ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at distal tips and along trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white mottling localized at the far left distal tip. Scattered white punctate spots (mottling) distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity banding present along the inner-trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate 65-70 degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 12% of the total visible vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations along the left lobe's trailing edge with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3-15 pixels. Right lobe exhibits lower frequency, smoother undulations with intermittent jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted from the distal tips toward the median notch; outer leading edges exhibit a convex trajectory emerging from the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups located at the extreme apex and outer boundary of the left lobe distal tip. Smaller clusters visible on the outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-vertical white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged trailing edge indicative of physical erosion; dense barnacle-site scarring at the distal apex of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated horizontal white linear mark approximately 100 pixels in length located on the inner-medial surface of the left lobe.
